Title: General availability: Azure Kubernetes Service in East Asia

Body.Content:
Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) is now generally available in East Asia (Hong Kong). It's the sixteenth Azure region to offer the service. In the list of regions, you can see where AKS is available and where it's coming next.

AKS offers a fully managed Kubernetes environment on Azure. It enables customers to spend less time managing infrastructure and more time building applications. To learn more, check out the AKS product page and documentation.
